description: The simulation tick rate is an ⚠️ ASSUMPTION config value (config.TICK_RATE); a literal number anywhere else is a rule that was never actually wired to config. Three shapes an implementer reaches for are covered, because a grep that only catches one shape passes silently past the others (F-14).
Every network call goes through src/net/client.ts, so retry, auth and logging live in one place instead of being re-implemented at each call site.
